subject: prd/docgate
statement: If If the ledger prefix cannot be read without one or more defects, then the system shall fail closed before congruence evaluation and preserve every underlying defect unchanged
intent: one defect per cause with its original artifact path, operation, reason, and remedy
fit_criterion: a fixture with multiple read defects returns all defects in stable order; none is rewritten against the added amendment or reduced to reason-only text
